status: registered before execution; evaluation-only (no training on external events)
question: Do the heads and updaters trained on the hiroshima event (P1 v0.3 seed 1) confirm landslides on three UNSEEN events (thrissur 2018-08, itogon 2018-09, hokkaido 2018-09) at the first valid post-event observation, with pre-event false alarms within budget, when thresholds are fixed on hiroshima validation?
train_source: p1_causal_v0_3 seed 1 checkpoints: updaters (ema, gru, gru_dt, resid_q, meta_only) and matched heads (last, gru_dt, prefix, resid_q). Nothing is re-fitted on external data.
thresholds: per arm, the tile-level 5% and 10% pre-event false-alarm thresholds computed on the hiroshima validation block in v0.3 (reused verbatim); realised pre-event FAR on each external event is reported and is the primary validity check
arms: frozen-readout reference arms (last, gru_dt, prefix) for continuity
metrics: per event: realised tile-level pre-event FAR, confirmation rate and never-confirmed count, latency A (event date) and B (first valid post-event observation), post-event mean IoU
event-level summary: number of events (of 3) where latest_head keeps confirmation >= 70% with realised FAR <= 2x budget
head_valid flag per event (realised FAR < 3x budget)

decision_rules.generalises: latest_head valid on >= 2 of 3 events with confirmation >= 70% at the 10% budget and latency B median <= 1 observation step
decision_rules.does_not_generalise: otherwise: the hiroshima head result (MS-137) is event-specific; report as such
decision_rules.memory_on_external: if any +head memory arm beats latest_head on post-event IoU by >= .03 on >= 2 events, revisit the v0.3 verdict

not_claimed: performance after re-fitting on the new events
any claim beyond Sentinel-2 landslide scars
statistical significance across events (n=3 events; reported per event)
